in_marathi.long_meaning: Vasudha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vasudha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'vasud' which means 'abode'. According to Hindu mythology, it is believed that Vasudha is the abode of all living beings. This name is also associated with the goddess of the same name, who is known to be the mother of all creatures.
